name: Stacked! Quality Pancakes Classic Thick-Cut Brioche French Toast
whyItWorks: Soft, crustless-style brioche soaked in egg custard and griddled golden brown digests easily with minimal fiber when topped with pure syrup or sliced bananas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Brioche French Toast with maple syrup (or banana topping)—skip raspberry/blackberry seedy syrups and lemon curd.
watchOuts: Contains egg and dairy in the brioche custard—take lactase if needed
